jobs.occupation: Project Procurement Manager (f/m/d) Execution (Projektleiter/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Project Procurement Manager, you represent Procurement in Project Management Teams, organizing all procurement activities within a project to optimize results. Your role is pivotal in ensuring implementing strategies to optimize project results and ensuring the quality, timely, and budgetary availability of Systems and Components.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Project Lead for Procurement in Execution Projects; Arrange the handover with the Proposal-PPM and initiate project-specific purchasing Kick Offs; Organize, monitor, and optimize all Procurement activities in a project
* Implement Procurement strategies to enhance project results
* Control project specifics sourcing processes to deliver optimum results in terms of budget, availability, timeline, and quality. Support project cost estimations with reliable and current cost data
* Analyze the scope of supply and contractual obligations, identifying risks, opportunities, changes throughout the project. Execute project specific Procurement strategies aligned with the Business Unit and Operating Company strategies
* Maintain communication with interface partners and ensure the best negotiation success together with the project buyers to meet the project targets. Manage the preferred supplier list and supplier qualifications for project execution phase
* Close Contact to Claim Management to clarify project specific claims to suppliers

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
* Long-term professional experience in procurement with a strong understanding of commercial, technical, project management, and international contract law.
* Interpersonal skills, thinking, creativity, drive, communication, intercultural competency, collaboration, negotiation, stakeholder & customer relationship management, problem-solving, data-driven decision-making, responsibility, and adaptability
* Advanced Digital, Technical & Functional Skills
* Excellent German and English language skills

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Contract Manager (f/m/d) (Vertragsberater/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:

In your role as a member of this team you will actively support the manifold activities coming along with the project business of Siemens Energy’s GS Solutions. The world is currently facing a transition of the energy market that is characterized by an increasing energy demand, and you will take responsibility for a broad variety of complex contractual matters in this exciting environment. Your primary task is the contractual support in the field of commercial contracts during the execution of national and international large-scale projects (EPC) by means of analyzing contracts, identifying contractual risks, drafting and negotiating agreements, and advising and supporting project and site management to tackle the challenges arising in large project business. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Provide advice and support to project and site management during execution of customer contracts, consortium agreements, and sub-contracts to protect Siemens Energy’s rights and entitlements
* Support contractual and commercial matters, including claim and change order processes as well as reviewing and drafting relevant correspondence
* Identify technical, commercial, and contractual aspects to establish project-specific claim strategies and support pursuing and defending incoming and outgoing claims
* Contribute to claim management through collection and evaluation of project records, documentation, and relevant facts, including support in settlement negotiations
* Collaborate with legal teams by substantiating cause-and-effect relationships to demonstrate entitlement to claims, extensions of time, or defenses in arbitration/ADR
* Supervise or perform quantum and delay analyses to establish causation for events impacting project schedule and scope of work

* Strong knowledge of international EPC and construction contracts (e.g. FIDIC, Orgalime, NEC, MF1)
* Ability to work collaboratively with project, site, and legal teams
* Fluent English and German negotiation skills; additional languages are a plus
* Experience working in international teams and with international contractual partners

We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.occupation: Legal Trainee/Rechtsreferendar/in, Q2 2027 (Fixed-Term Contract) (English, German) (Justiziar/in)
jobs.description:
This program is intended for students currently pursuing legal qualifications, who are returning to studies after the completion of the program.
Please note this job posting is only for traineeship starting April/May/June 2027 for 3-4 months fixed-term contract.
Please specify your preferred start dates and availability on your CV.
Minimum qualifications:
Current enrollment in compulsory legal training (Station im Rahmen des Referendariats).
First legal state exam completion (Erstes Staatsexamen).
Ability to communicate in English and German fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience in legal analysis and research.
Experience building relationships and communicating with people at all levels.
Experience in data protection, copyright, technology, or media law.
Experience working on numerous projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Interest in technology and IT-relevant legal problems and recent developments.
Available to start between April and June 2027 for a 3-4 months fixed-term contract.
About the Job
As a Legal Trainee (Rechtsreferendar/in), and part of the Google regional Legal team, you will help to respond to legal challenges in the information age. You will get an insight into a variety of legal challenges at Google and YouTube, learning to expect the unexpected while actively promoting the development of internet law in an unconventional environment. The legal department of Google (Google Rechtsabteilung Hamburg) offers an optional training period as part of your compulsory legal training (Wahlstation/Anwaltsstation während des Referendariats).
In this role, you will enhance your organizational skills, attention to detail, versatility and composure, while also getting the opportunity to demonstrate that you have sound legal judgment, can learn quickly in a fast-paced environment, and can communicate confidently at all levels.
20th century laws don't always solve 21st century problems, and Google Legal crafts innovative approaches for working with some of the toughest legal challenges of the information age. Whether you're a patent attorney, an intellectual property expert or an engineer headed to law school, Google Legal lets you address unanswered legal quandaries and create new precedents. Our innovative services raise challenging questions that demand creative and practical answers. We provide those answers by working at the crossroads of the law and new technology, helping Google build innovative and important products for users around the world.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Germany: €44500 (EUR) + 15% bonus target
Learn more about benefits at Google.* Assist in a variety of projects such as the localization of Google Products and the review and drafting of agreements.
Conduct research on a variety of legal topics including intellectual property, consumer regulations, media regulations, advertising, data protection, etc.
Respond to various legal requests from users and third-parties in relation to Google services.
Assist the Legal team in the preparation and the management of court actions.
Participate in the creation and maintenance of internal knowledge databases for the Legal team.

jobs.occupation: Working student within Software Engineering (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Windtunnel Test team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working student within Software Engineering (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Windtunnel Testengineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Windtunnel Test team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Bremen
- Start: 01.10.2026
- Duration: 12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €19.10 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Feature Development: You will support our team in developing and implementing new features for our Wind Tunnel Environment
- Quality Assurance: You will help us maintain high standards by writing unit tests and assisting in bug fixing.
- Collaboration: You will participate in regular meetings and task planning
- Independent Work: After your onboarding, you should work independently on your own tasks and sub-projects.
- Technical Support: You will assist in documenting and optimizing existing codebases.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled fulltime student (d/f/m) in a Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related degree program (minimum 3rd semester achieved).
- You have a solid grasp of at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, Java)
- You understand the basics of version control (Git) and are eager to learn professional workflows.
- Problem Solver Mindset: You are curious, proactive, and not afraid to ask "why?".
- You are fluent in English or German and enjoy working in a collaborative environment.
- Mastering Message Brokers: There is a chance that you will dive deep into event-driven architectures. A key part of your role could be learning and implementing messaging systems like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ to connect our microservices.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: Customs Specialist (m/f/d) (Speditionskaufmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Vestas Northern and Central Europe (NCE) is a sales business unit covering Scandinavia, the UK, Ireland, Poland, the Baltics, Germany and Benelux. The business unit is responsible for the full value chain of wind farm projects across these regions, including Sales, Project Execution, Installation, and Service.

Our ambition is to be the best performing business unit within Vestas while also making Vestas Northern and Central Europe the best place to work. We strive for excellence through collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

The department is characterized by an open and informal culture, where teamwork, strong communication, and mutual support are key to our success. Employees are offered the opportunity to work in a dynamic and fast paced industry, alongside a team of highly motivated and experienced professionals contributing to the delivery of sustainable energy solutions.

Responsibilities:

Customs within Vestas Northern and Central Europe (NCE) has the overall responsibility for ensuring a well functioning import and export setup that supports business operations across the NCE region at the lowest possible total cost, while fully complying with internal policies and external customs laws and regulations.

The role covers both strategic and operational customs activities and includes close collaboration with internal stakeholders, customs brokers, and external authorities.

Key responsibilities include:

- Addressing and supporting customs related topics in connection with new market entries and project setups
- Supporting, coordinating, and monitoring the customs broker operations across the NCE region
- Assisting Sales Business Units with customs related due diligence calculations and assessments
- Participating in the development of customs concepts, standards, and processes across regions with the objective of reducing overall operating costs
- Handling operational customs activities and day to day customs matters within the NCE region
- Preparing and supporting customs audits, including documentation and follow up actions
- Ensuring that all relevant stakeholders are proactively informed about customs matters and regulatory changes with potential compliance, cost, or operational impact

Qualifications:

- Experience from a customs compliance or customs operations function in an international business environment
- Hands on experience working with or within a Customs Broker organization, including coordination and oversight activities
- Formal training or education in Customs Compliance, International Trade, or a related field
- Solid understanding of international trade terminology and customs procedures
- Familiarity with import and export processes, customs documentation, and regulatory requirements
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple stakeholders across functions and regions
- Strong oral and written communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered an advantage

Competencies:

- Ability to navigate, communicate, and collaborate effectively with customs authorities as well as with diverse internal stakeholders across functions and regions
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex customs topics in a clear and structured manner
- Capability to analyze, document, and outline processes, and to propose practical and sustainable implementation strategies
- A structured and solution oriented mindset, enabling effective handling of complex customs topics in a dynamic business environment

Your benefits - because your contribution counts:

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit

You also coordinate supplier inquiries and evaluate offers. jobs.description:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

As Project Lead for Network Detection & Response Evaluation, you will drive the selection and proof of concept validation of an Network Detection & Response solution and ensure it fits our Security Operations Center operating model and technical landscape. You will coordinate cross-functional teams, define success criteria, manage risks (e.g., performance, integration, compliance), and deliver a decision-ready recommendation including a roadmap from PoC to operational rollout.

Your tasks include the folliwing responsibilities:

- Leading the structured evaluation and selection of a Network Detection and Response solution, including requirements definition, vendor comparison, and decision preparation
- Planning and executing a proof of concept to validate detection capabilities, operational fit, and technical feasibility in a Security Operations Center environment
- Defining and aligning target use cases and success criteria for network-based threat detection and response, focusing on visibility gaps and anomaly detection
- Driving the integration concept into existing Security Operations Center tooling and processes, ensuring alignment with monitoring, investigation, and response workflows
- Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across cyber security, infrastructure, and network domains to ensure alignment on architecture, data sources, and deployment approach
- Evaluating the reuse and integration of existing network telemetry and sensor data to optimize cost, complexity, and time-to-value
- Developing and documenting a target operating model for network-based threat detection and response within cyber security operations
- Identifying and managing key project risks, including performance impact, integration complexity, resource constraints, and data protection requirements
- Preparing management-ready recommendations, including solution comparison, risk assessment, and roadmap towards implementation and operationalization

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in a related field or comparable qualification
- Proven experience in leading cyber security or information technology projects on enterprise level, ideally in evaluation or implementation of detection and monitoring capabilities.
- Strong understanding of network-based threat detection and response principles, including behavioral analytics and anomaly detection approaches.
- Practical knowledge of enterprise network environments and data sources within large-scale enterprise environments, such as network flow data and traffic analysis approaches.
- Experience working with Security Operations Center environments and related platforms, including monitoring, alerting, and incident handling processes.
- Demonstrated ability to design and execute structured evaluation processes and proof of concepts with clear success criteria.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business-relevant recommendations.
- Solid understanding of compliance, governance, and data protection requirements in cyber security contexts
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)

Advantageous

- Experience in integrating detection and monitoring solutions into complex enterprise environments, including cross-domain architectures.
- Background in threat hunting, detection engineering, or incident response.
- Familiarity with network and endpoint security technologies and their interaction within a holistic security architecture.
- Experience in environments combining information technology and operational technology with specific monitoring requirements.
- Relevant certifications in project management or cyber security.

Additional Information

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

Finkenwerder

Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.

- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Get precise! You will dive deep into the world of measurement systems within our fuselage assembly, supporting the setup, testing, and evaluation of high-precision metrology tools.
- Crunch some numbers! You’ll collect, structure, analyze, and visualize measurement data that drives real change in how we align and join aircraft sections.
- Become a precision ninja! Help us optimize measurement concepts, evaluate tolerances, and ensure all fuselage components fit together like clockwork.
- Unleash your creativity! We want your input on automating data analysis and simplifying our measurement processes, so the fun stuff gets more focus.
- Show your skills! Present your findings in our weekly team meetings—you’ll be a key part of the conversation, not a coffee runner.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You’re enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in something awesome like Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Metrology (Messtechnik), Industrial Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
- Got some skills? If you’ve dabbled in 3D measurement technologies, laser tracking, CAD, or data analytics, that’s a massive plus!
- Languages! Fluent in English and German? Perfect! French? Even better!
- A proactive attitude and a talent for making sense of chaos—able to structure your work, handle highly precise data, and communicate results effectively.

Job description

CTC is looking for an

Intern in the field of structural mechanics (d/f/m), focus on material modelling for thermoplastic composites

Thermoplastic composites offer a number of advantages for the aviation industry, but their processing at high temperatures is a complex task. jobs.occupation: Data Center Facilities Technician, Electrical (English, German) (m/w/d) (Leitende/r Haustechniker/in)
jobs.description:
This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Minimum qualifications:

- Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 2 years of experience with Electrical Distribution Systems (High Voltage, Low Voltage, Protection and Controls, Power Quality).
- Ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends and holidays on shift based schedules as required.
- Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting and work on platforms, ladders, and under raised floors.
- Ability to communicate in English and German fluently to work with colleagues.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience planning and executing installation, commissioning, and equipment startup, following industry best practices and protocols.
- Experience working in the control room for critical operations.
- Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems in data center environments and controls/monitoring systems.
- Excellent written, verbal communication and people management skills, with the ability to prioritize work efficiently.

About the Job

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving channel behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
***** Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.

- Manage the uptime and maintenance of UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.
- Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
- Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new electrical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.
